rows.label: tlk502104_msg0002
rows.name:
I gathered some grass.
Now I'm going to make a crown!

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0004
rows.name: Do you like grass, trees, and nature?

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0005
rows.name:
Yeah! I love 'em, and I like to play
with them! And you can find 'em
anywhere, so you can play anywhere!

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0007
rows.name:
Want to make one with me too,
Onee-chan?

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0008
rows.name: Ah, no. I'll give it a miss.

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0011
rows.name:
Okay... Well, I'll give
you this anyway, because
we made friends today!

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0012
rows.name:
This is a really nice
pendant. Are you sure it's
okay for me to have it?

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0013
rows.name:
I don't really understand,
but I got it from a kind
mercenary lady, so it's fine.

rows.label: tlk502104_msg0014
rows.name:
I'll be okay with the grass
crown and a grass bracelet!
